product.title: Chinatown and Little Italy Food Tour | Tasty Tours NYC
product.description: Come hungry to this walking tour of Chinatown and Little Italy. Explore these two neighborhoods with a guide and sample a range of authentic foods such as pan fried dumplings, roasted pork buns, Hong Kong style sponge cakes, sweet Thai tea, pizza, handmade gnocchi, and cannoli. Enrich yourself while you fill your belly–you’ll learn about the two neighborhoods’ distinct histories and landmarks.
highlights: Instead of a single meal, try several of the city’s best foods in one sitting
Discover unassuming food spots that are difficult to find on your own
Private and small-group tour option offer a more personal experience
Choice of morning or afternoon tour times to suit your schedule

start.description: Tasty Dumpling, 42 Mulberry St, New York, NY 10013, USA. We'll start our tour at Tasty Dumpling. Your tour guide will meet you outside the front of the store.

end.description: Eileen's Special Cheesecake, 17 Cleveland Pl, New York, NY 10012, USA. Our tour will finish at Eileen's Special Cheesecake and your guide will assist you with directions to ensure a safe journey home.
